maya: quick note from today's bring-up: tested triton-optimized 30b-quant (dynamic 8->6) with speculative prefetch lookahead=5 on staging.

tony: quick numbers?

maya: median latency -18% (200ms -> 164ms), token cost -21%. p95 unchanged.

evan: any quality regressions?

maya: small lego: increased early-token repetition and a handful of short hallucinations on QA prompts. nothing catastrophic but measurable.

tony: logs?

ci-bot: deploy finished: shard s-09, model triton-30b-quant. logs: /ops/logs/1901234567. flagged: "prefetch-gap at tok=12" x12.

maya: sample: 
```
Q: Who wrote "Pride and Prejudice"?
A: Jane Austen. Jane Austen wrote the novel Jane Austen wrote the novel in 1813.
```

evan: classic sign of stale-kv reuse after fallback. quant smoothing sometimes increases chance that prefetch predicts wrong branch.

tony: propose 3 quick experiments: (A) lookahead=3, (B) lookahead=5 + kv-validate, (C) lookahead=5 + temp=1.08 on attention logits. 400 ex commons-qa, seeds 13/21. collect ppl, repeat-rate, latency.

maya: launching now:
```
onboard --model triton-30b-quant --spec true --lookahead 3 --group A --samples 400 --seed 13
onboard --model triton-30b-quant --spec true --lookahead 5 --kv-validate true --group B --samples 400 --seed 13
onboard --model triton-30b-quant --spec true --lookahead 5 --temp 1.08 --group C --samples 400 --seed 21
```

evan: also dump first-64 logits and eos probabilities for 100 examples.

maya: quick results (seed 13/21):
A (lookahead=3): ppl +0.15, repeat-rate 0.7%, median latency +7ms.
B (kv-validate): ppl +0.04, repeat-rate 0.2%, median latency +9ms.
C (temp=1.08): ppl +0.28, repeat-rate 1.3%, median latency -10ms.

tony: kv-validate looks like the best quality/perf tradeoff for this quant profile.

evan: actionable: set default lookahead=4 for triton-30b-quant, enable kv-validate opt-in for QA routes, add console metric "repeat-rate" and alert at 1%.

ci-bot: note created: onboarding/1901234567-triton-30b-quant (PR pending).

tony: next steps: weekend experiment to try attention fp16 + rest quant to see if we can safely use lookahead=5.
